[color=#c9b490][size=3][center] This are only tilesheets. If a mod requires "Alvadea's Tilesheets" - download it and put it in your Mods Folder.

They can be used as modding resource for building maps. Just integrate it as dependency. (Do not re-upload this tilesheet as part of your mod!)
It contains a lot of animation tiles and I know that makes it look a bit chaotic, but I hope my explanation picture will help you understand how to use my tilesheet for your own projects. The "cliffs in the water" part is not complete for every single cliff structure you can build in the game, but for my custom map it was enough variety. With future updates I'll try to make this as universal as possible, since I always get triggered by cliffs standing on top of the water. xD [/center][/size][/color]
